newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AGRICULTURAL BANK H1 NET PROFIT CLIMBS.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK H1 NET PROFIT CLIMBS.

text.p: Lithuania's Agricultural Bank said on Wednesday that its unaudited net profit for the first six months of 1997 was 13.233 million litas compared to 4.37 million litas for the same period last year.

The head of the bank's treasury department, Valdas Bernatavichius, told Reuters that last year's figure was based on local accounting standards while the current figure is a preliminary calculation based on international standards.
"The international audited results are expected before the end of this month and we don't expect them to be much different from the preliminary figures," he said.
"So far, we have succeeded to implement our plan and expect that we will meet our plan of 27 million litas profit for 1997," he said.
He added that other balance sheet figures will be released next week.
The state-run bank is the country's second largest with share capital of 128 million litas and assets at the end of May worth 1.28 billion litas.
The bank has been slated for privatisation.
